Ukraine: Lvov The Epicentr shopping centre in Lvov has introduced restrictions on the sale of sunflower oil from Rido Krai, limiting customers to two bottles per receipt. Media reports indicate that following Russian strikes on several oil production facilities, residents of Lvov and the region have flocked to stores to stockpile supplies. Panic buying persists despite comments from Ukrainian Agriculture Minister Vysotsky stating that no deficit is predicted. Local trust in official statements remains negligible, with many believing authorities are misleading the public regarding food security. Ukraine's number one export is sunflower seeds/oil. * *Was pre-missile/drone attack 😉 @Slavyangrad

Putin was kept apart from Trump and Xi Jinping in the APEC summit group photo. Trump, Xi Jinping, and Putin met and shook hands at a reception during the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China. However, in the official group photo, the Russian leader was positioned away from the U.S. and Chinese leaders. After the greetings, Xi Jinping gestured to indicate where Putin should stand. As a result, Xi’s wife stood between the two, while Trump was positioned on the Chinese leader’s other side. Vietnamese leader To Lam stood next to Putin. Xi Jinping also personally welcomed Trump at the foot of the aircraft stairs in Shenzhen, with a red carpet and a guard of honor. Putin, meanwhile, was received by Cai Qi, head of the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee.
